paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah, chapter 2, halakhah 9: he recited [a teaching] before R' Dosa (the Amora), and R' Dosa said to him, 'Retract!' But R' Zeira said to him, 'Do not retract.'[^1][^2]

notes.text: 2h 9 is explicit; Jerusalem Talmud is suggested by format rather than named or newly verified. Ulla is the natural implicit reciter/addressee, not an impersonal it-was-taught formulation. A teaching is a bracketed unstated object. Both opposing instructions and the negation are retained.

The Amora parenthesis belongs to Hyman, distinguishing his Dosa usage without a canonical identity claim. It does not expand the title. All three personal-title abbreviations remain R'; Ulla is untitled.
